proofs.Std.HashMap.any_eq_true_iff_exists_mem_g:
:= by
  simp only [← any_toList, List.any_eq_true, Prod.exists,
    mem_toList_iff_getKey?_eq_some_and_getElem?_eq_some, getElem?_eq_some_iff,
    getKey?_eq_some_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h'
    rcases h' with ⟨a, b, h', hp⟩
    rcases h' with ⟨ha, h₁, hb⟩
    rcases ha with ⟨h₂, ha⟩
    exists a
    exists h₁
    simp [ha, hb, hp]
  · intro h'
    rcases h' with ⟨a, h', hp⟩
    exists m.getKey a h'
    exists m[a]'h'
    simp only [hp, and_true]
    have ha : m.getKey a h' ∈ m := by
      apply mem_of_getKey?_eq_some
      rw [getKey?_eq_some_iff (k := a)]
      exists h'
    simp [ha, getKey_congr (getKey_beq h'), getElem_congr (getKey_beq h')]

proofs.Std.HashMap.union_insert_right_equiv_ins:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  refine (Model.toListModel_union m₁ (m₂.insert p.fst p.snd)).trans ?_
  refine List.Perm.trans ?_ (Model.toListModel_insert (m₁ ∪ m₂)).symm
  refine (insertList_perm_of_perm_second (Model.toListModel_insert m₂) (Model.distinctKeys m₁)
    (Model.distinctKeys _)).trans ?_
  refine (insertList_insertEntry_right_equiv_insertEntry_insertList ⟨p.fst, p.snd⟩
    (Model.distinctKeys m₁) (Model.distinctKeys m₂)).trans ?_
  exact insertEntry_of_perm (Model.distinctKeys m₁).insertList
    (Model.toListModel_union m₁ m₂).symm
